MotorCan100Cmd.description: Payload of CAN frame 0x100 from byte 2 on, as copied into RAM by mcu_can_rx_command_dispatch. Only the 16-bit fields are listed; the bytes before it (0x20001FD2..0x20001FD3) are a separate object.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Flag word: 0x10 counter enable (0x200003BE), 0x4 drive-mode test bit, 0x200 GPIOC pin 10 follow, 0x1000 and 0x2000 position-tracker edge inputs, 0x4000 run check.

fields.name: cmd_a
fields.description: Command magnitude: bits 0..13 are a 14-bit magnitude (scaled to Q15 by the drive code), bits 14..15 are a 2-bit mode that multiplies the high byte of cmd_b in mcu_cmd_ramp_update.

fields.name: cmd_b
fields.description: Low byte: 8-bit command scaled by 0x8000 (Q15). High byte: second 8-bit command used as the slew and ramp target.

MotorCan20cSetpoints.description: Setpoint and bound pair copied from payload bytes 2..5 of CAN frame 0x20C by the CAN dispatcher path. Read by the drive-state and limiter code.

fields.name: setpoint
fields.description: Low byte: threshold (x+1)*0x4000 compared with 0x20000F30, bit 0 selects a slew path. High byte: Q15-scaled 8-bit setpoint.

fields.name: limit
fields.description: Two 8-bit bounds in Q15 scaling: low byte and high byte, the larger of the two is stored by mcu_limiter_set_range.
